meta.name: data-governance
meta.description: Establishes ownership, definitions, quality, access, and lineage for the organization's data. Use this when metrics disagree between teams, when nobody knows which dataset is authoritative, when setting up data ownership or access policy, when data quality is unreliable, or before opening a dataset to a wider audience.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理清数据归属与口径,让指标对齐可信
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队常为数据口径争吵,却找不到权威数据源
copy.tagline_en: Clarify data ownership and definitions for trustworthy metrics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team argues over metrics and lacks a trusted data source

howto.what: 它会围绕组织数据展开治理:先用通俗语言写清每个业务指标的定义、计算方式、负责人和已知缺陷,并梳理血缘;再为每个数据集指定负责人,设定新鲜度、数量等质量检查,默认开放内部非个人数据的访问权限,同时避免两个系统争当同一事实的唯一来源。
howto.when: 当团队间指标口径不一致、不知道哪个数据集是权威,或需要设定数据所有权/访问策略等治理议题时触发。

say.text: 我们两个团队对“活跃客户”口径不一致,请对比两边的定义和计算逻辑。
say.note: 会摆出两个口径的分歧点。

say.text: 为“月度经常性收入”指标写字典:定义、计算公式、负责人和注意事项。
say.note: 得到一份可共享的指标字典条目。

say.text: 为 CRM 数据设计质量检查,含新鲜度、行数和唯一性规则。
say.note: 生成持续质量测试建议。

howto.what_en: Establishes data governance: documents each metric with plain-language definition, computation, owner, and caveats; assigns a named owner per dataset; sets data-quality checks; defaults internal access to open; tracks lineage.
howto.when_en: Triggered when metrics disagree, when no authoritative dataset is known, or when setting ownership/access policy; also when data quality is unreliable or opening data to a wider audience.

say_en.text: Our teams disagree on 'active customer'. Compare both definitions and formulas.
say_en.note: Shows the difference and what each one counts.

say_en.text: Document the metric 'MRR': definition, formula, owner, caveats.
Design quality checks for CRM data: freshness, row count, uniqueness.
